changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO process_link ( id, process_definition_id, activity_id, activity_type, process_link_type, component_key, form_definition_id, view_model_enabled, form_display_type, form_size, subtitles, process_link_url, action_properties, plugin_configuration_id, plugin_action_definition_key, reference_type, plugin_definition_key, form_flow_definition_key ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), bsn.process_definition_id, 'create-initiator-zaak-rol-kvk', bsn.activity_type, bsn.process_link_type, bsn.component_key, bsn.form_definition_id, bsn.view_model_enabled, bsn.form_display_type, bsn.form_size, bsn.subtitles, bsn.process_link_url, bsn.action_properties, bsn.plugin_configuration_id, bsn.plugin_action_definition_key, bsn.reference_type, bsn.plugin_definition_key, bsn.form_flow_definition_key FROM process_link bsn JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = bsn.process_definition_id LEFT JOIN process_link kvk ON kvk.process_definition_id = bsn.process_definition_id AND kvk.activity_id = 'create-initiator-zaak-rol-kvk' WHERE pd.key_ = 'create-zaakdossier' AND bsn.activity_id = 'create-initiator-zaak-rol' AND kvk.id IS NULL
